question: Does list_participants expose enough to bind a participant id to a party (name, kind, linked user)?
summary: list_participants fields: id, name, type, status, alias. Message events carry sender "@switch-agent-bba75a09:localhost" and sender_name "master-sim". The participant list id is an agent uuid, not the @ sender id, and carries no linked user. Binding therefore uses the @ sender id learned at enrolment, or an explicit name entry.
caveats: Agents only. For a human on a messaging app, on_behalf_of and the linked Switch user were not observable without a real platform account.
environment: switch-core started from the cloned repository with a local Postgres, no Docker, in a Claude Code cloud session. Not the Codespace server.
